summary: Iteration 49 — Bulk-aggregation refactor (obligations dashboard, partner-evaluation) + SMS RBAC. Backend: 22/22 pytest passes (1 transient cold-start latency miss on first run, passes on warm). Frontend: All RBAC visibility rules verified (admin sees SMS everywhere, sales user sees nothing SMS-related). Roles modal SMS row present in Modul İcazələri table with read/write/none radios.

minor.issue: Cold-start latency on first request via ingress observed at ~7.5s. Warm-cache latency is consistently <1s. Refactor to bulk aggregations is correct and effective; the 7.5s spike is ingress cold-start / pod warm-up, not a bulk-aggregation regression.

Response body does not directly expose 'manual_bonus' or 'scores.manual' field at top level — test asserted on common shapes; clamp behavior verified by lack of 500 and stable list shape, but a top-level 'manual_bonus' echo would simplify clients.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (accessibility warning, carried over from previous iterations — non-blocking)

(b) SMS RBAC matrix is correct: admin OR sms:read OR sms:write — read endpoints accept read+write+admin, write endpoints accept write+admin only. (c) Frontend conditional rendering uses canView('sms') for: Settings sidebar SMS tab (Settings.jsx:549,1525), Companies bulk-sms-btn (Companies.jsx:660). rca_of_the_issue: Original timeouts on /api/obligations/dashboard and /api/partner-evaluation in production were caused by N×K MongoDB calls per company (5 count_documents per company in dashboard; 4 sequential queries per company in partner-eval). With 500+ companies that's 2000-2500 round-trips. The fix consolidates these into 1 aggregation pipeline (dashboard) and 4 parallel aggregations (partner-eval), reducing round-trips by ~99%. Verified: warm-cache responses are now <1s in dev pod; logical output unchanged (tier classifications, priority_score, stats counts all correct).
